headline: Luigi Mangione 🍝💥 CEO KILL PLEA GUILTY 💀🏛️
text: Luigi Mangione 🍝😈 just DROPPED THE MIC 🎤💦 in Manhattan federal court 🏛️🔥 admitting 'I SHOT Mr Thompson in Manhattan and he DIED 💀💨!' The 28-year-old back-pain warrior 🦴😩 pled guilty to interstate stalking resulting in death after years of UnitedHealthcare denial HELL 🔥🏥. Brian Thompson, 50-year-old daddy of two 👨‍👧‍👦 was popped from behind at a midtown hotel on Dec 4, 2024 like a 3D-printed silencer SPECIAL 🤫🔫. Mangione printed the GLOCK himself with a silencer and mag like a DIY MURDER MASTERCLASS 📚💣. He emailed UnitedHealthcare pretending to be an INVESTOR 💼😈 just to scope out the investor conference like a healthcare CEO STALKER EXTRAORDINAIRE 🕵️‍♂️📧. Thompson's family called it 'an important step toward JUSTICE ⚖️💔' while Mangione faces LIFE IN PRISON 🏢🔒. Prosecutors recommend 24-30 years but Judge Margaret Garnett said 'NOT BINDING, MAX IS LIFE BABY 💀👑!' Meanwhile his lawyers are screaming DOUBLE JEOPARDY 🚫⚖️ trying to nuke the New York state case with 8 charges including second-degree MURDER 🔪 and fake ID crimes 📄😏. Manhattan DA says 'WE'RE STILL COMING FOR YOU 🍕⚔️' while Mangione's defense says he's taken 'FULL RESPONSIBILITY' like a true crime podcast GUEST STAR 🎙️💯. Sentencing drops Dec 18 – will it be 24 years or LIFE WITHOUT PAROLE? 🍝💀 The healthcare CEO assassination saga continues with Mangione's guilty plea throwing a MASSIVE WRENCH 🔧 into state proceedings like a plot twist nobody saw coming 📺😱!
